REPORT

Subject Re International Protective and Enquiry Agency

Made by **〔此处为点线〕** and **〔此处为点线〕** Forwarded by Supt. Bennett

Sir,

Otto Boisserie, proprietor of this agency with offices at room 308, 120 Nanking Road, was again the subject of complaint in respect to the action of detectives employed in this agency (F.I.R. 1876/40 Louza, Misc. 475/40 Central).

The files respecting these cases and D.9246/39 were given to Mr. Lamb, H.B.M. Consulate, on 8/5/40 for perusal.

Otto Boisserie attended H.B.M. Consulate on 18/6/40 at the request of Mr. Lamb after being warned by Supt. Bennett to attend, for two (2) letters addressed to him (Boisserie) requesting him to attend had been ignored.

Mr. Lamb informed Supt. Bennett on 19/6/40 that Boisserie had been warned that he would be held responsible for any illegal actions of his employees, and should any further complaints re these employees be received by S.M. Police, the complete file re this agency would be passed to the Crown Advocate for consideration re any possible legal proceedings.

Mr. Lamb requested particulars of any further complaints that may be received respecting this agency.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 21 JUNE 1940）

D. C. Davis

由 **〔此处为点线〕** 和 **〔此处为点线〕** 制作，由贝内特警司转呈

先生，

该机构业主奥托·布瓦瑟雷（Otto Boisserie），办公地点位于南京路120号308室，再次因其雇佣的侦探的行为而遭到投诉（F.I.R. 1876/40 卢家湾分局，杂项 475/40 中央分局）。

关于这些案件及 D.9246/39 号案件的档案已于1940年5月8日交给英国驻沪总领事馆的兰姆先生（Mr. Lamb）审阅。

奥托·布瓦瑟雷在受到贝内特警司警告要求出席后，于1940年6月18日应兰姆先生的要求前往英国驻沪总领事馆，此前他曾无视两封要求其出席的信件。

兰姆先生于1940年6月19日告知贝内特警司，已警告布瓦瑟雷，他将对其雇员的任何非法行为承担责任；如果上海公共租界警务处再收到关于这些雇员的投诉，有关该机构的完整档案将移交给皇家检察官，以考虑是否采取法律行动。

兰姆先生要求提供可能收到的关于该机构的任何其他投诉的详情。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处总监办公室 1940年6月21日）
